title: Generative modeling for fusion: a large-scale benchmark of stellarator fast-ion simulations
note: Preprint — the review link in the body is still the placeholder openreview.net/forum?id=XXXX. Every figure in this report is from v1. Full text retrieved from arxiv.org/html/2610.37910.

title: BoSS — Benchmark of Stellarator Simulations (official site)
note: Licensing (data CC BY 4.0, code and models Apache 2.0), citation guidance, installation instructions. Data body (3TB) requires Globus + institutional/Google/ORCID login via /download.html.

title: boss_bench repository (PyPI: boss-bench v1.0.0)
note: Metric computation code (Python 3.9+). Data generation code not included.

title: mishapadidar/boss — trained models (loss-fraction prediction, heat-load sampling, inverse design)
note: Apache 2.0, ONNX included. Checked 2026-11-02: zero likes, no download count.

title: ConStellaration: A dataset of QI-like stellarator plasma boundaries and optimization benchmarks
container-title: NeurIPS 2025 Datasets & Benchmarks Track (arXiv:2506.19583, v1 2025-06-24, v2 2025-11-26)
note: Source of the 'without querying expensive physics oracles' phrase and the ~158,000 scale figure (paper's own wording).

title: ConStellaration Design Leaderboard
note: Still operating October 2026. Source of 69/44/51 submissions and 39/20/6 users. Server re-evaluation evidenced by this Space's evaluation.py and app.py admin re-scoring path, plus pinned-version note in repo docs.

title: Diffusion for Fusion: Designing Stellarators with Generative AI
note: Source of 'less than 5% deviation from quasisymmetry' scoring criterion. Not the same model as the diffusion model in Table 1 of BoSS.

title: QUASR database
note: Continuously updated dataset — size cited as 200,000 / 300,000 / 370,000 depending on citation date; this report uses a range.

title: Nonlinear gyrokinetic ITG turbulence simulations (over 200,000 runs)
note: Composition behind the 200,000 figure differs across sources; this report uses only the paper's verbatim total. Churchill et al., arXiv:2609.28730 (2026) is a separate dataset run with different code, not an expanded edition.

title: WeatherBench: A benchmark dataset for data-driven weather forecasting
note: Referenced as outside grounding for the null-baseline (persistence) practice.

title: Public dataset cost-comparison set: Open Catalyst OC20/OC22, OMat24, Materials Project, AlphaFold DB, The Well
note: Used to establish that only BoSS and OMat24 state cost in compute-hours, and only Open Catalyst family + ConStellaration have a scoring service. OC-family core-hour figures vary too widely between sources to quote.

title: The Global Fusion Industry in 2026
note: Source for private fusion investment context. Individual-company funding totals differ between sources and are not used in the body.
